# tomswallapi_secmark (Resource)

An SELinux security-marking rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_secmark" "http" {
  secmark = "system_u:object_r:http_packet_t:s0"
  chain   = "I:N"
  proto   = "tcp"
  dport   = ["80"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `chain` (String) P/I/F/O/T with optional state.
- `secmark` (String) SELinux context, or save/restore.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `dest` (String) Destination to match (zone, interface, or address in shorewall notation).
- `dport` (List of String) Destination ports or port ranges to match.
- `proto` (String) Protocol to match (tcp, udp, icmp, ...).
- `source` (String) Source to match (zone, interface, or address in shorewall notation).
- `sport` (List of String) Source ports or port ranges to match.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_secmark.http 42
```
